review_subject: Customer web auth + order tracker — tests/e2e/test-e2e-abuse-L-customer-tracker.spec.js, artifacts tests/e2e/__screenshots__/test-e2e-L/ (5 states x quartet). Capture passed 4/4.
context_not_defects: L-PLAN-01 (already documented by author, spec header lines 11-47): the AUDIT_PLAN's anonymous '#+phone' order tracker DOES NOT EXIST in this codebase. TrackOrderComponent.vue is a logged-in active-order banner; there is no public guest order-read route (all /api/order reads are auth:sanctum, api.php:1311). KEY ASSERTION was correctly REFRAMED onto the authenticated /my-orders/:id detail page. This is context, NOT a defect.
STAFF_ONLY_MODE was flipped to false for this run so the customer wall is reachable (spec lines 114-118). Context, not a defect.

L-SEED-01 (documented): place-order.js creates kiosk-token orders not attributed to a customer account; no public API creates a walkingcustomer-owned order from the test layer. In THIS run the shared dev DB already held customer-owned orders so the populated branch (03) + KEY ASSERT (04) were both reached — the seeding gap did not block.

audit_integrity_assessment.key_assertion_serial_match: REAL and HARD-ASSERTED. Spec lines 327-335 capture the clicked row's serial (#0306264118, row 1 of state 03) BEFORE navigation, then assert getByText(/#\s*0306264118\b/) is visible on the detail page. State-04 DOM contains EXACTLY ONE order serial (#0306264118) — it matches the clicked row, and no second/other-customer order leaked. The 'tracker resolves the correct order' assertion genuinely passes. VERIFIED.
audit_integrity_assessment.live_status_no_stale_half: NOT genuinely verified. The spec's secondary 'status syncs live / no stale badge' cross-check (lines 337-342) is only `expect(page.locator('section').first()).toBeVisible()` — it asserts a section exists, NOT that the status is fresh. Empirically the detail status ('En préparation' / progress node at 'Commande En préparation') matched the row badge ('En préparation'), so no defect is observed — but the freshness half of the KEY ASSERTION is an existence check, not a freshness check. Faithful answer: serial-match half is real; live-status half is weakly asserted (no defect found empirically).

findings.evidence: Header cart button (between the 'Français' selector and the 'Compte' dropdown) renders as a solid dark-navy pill with NO visible content. DOM (04.dom.html): . tailwind.config.js:32 defines heading=#1F1F39, so foreground (text-heading #1F1F39) sits on background (bg-heading #1F1F39) => measured contrast ratio = 1.00:1 (identical color, far below WCAG AA 4.5:1). The cart bag icon AND the live cart total '0.00€' are INVISIBLE to all sighted users on EVERY customer page. The button is icon+amount only and carries NO aria-label (grep: 'aria-label' absent on the webcart element) => icon-only control also opaque to screen readers (category 8). This is the genuine defect the Wave L spec MISSED: it only asserted login (#formEmail/#formPassword), the my-orders list, and the detail serial — it never asserted the persistent header cart control is legible. P2 per the P1-objectivity rule (measured contrast is a category-4 P2; missing aria is a category-8 P2); flagged as the strongest finding because it is a primary purchase-path control invisible on 100% of customer pages.
findings.fix_hint: Header cart button class 'text-heading bg-heading' (dark-on-dark). Either set text-white on bg-heading, or bg-light/bg-transparent with text-heading. Add aria-label (e.g. label.cart / 'Panier {total}'). Component: the frontend layout header (web Vue layout); class 'webcart' is the locator. Confirm against the empty-cart count badge styling.

findings.evidence: Customer-facing footer column heading reads 'Useful Liens' — a mixed-locale string (English 'Useful' + French 'Liens'), clearly visible in the orange footer of state 05 and state 02. Root cause: resources/js/languages/fr.json:1244 "useful_links": "Useful Liens" — the FRENCH translation value itself was left half-English. Compare en.json:834 "Useful Links", de.json:400 "Nützliche Links", ar.json:664 proper Arabic, bn.json:400 proper Bengali — only the FR value is botched. This is a genuine translation defect on the FR locale (the site's default), visible on every page footer. CLASSIFIED P2 (not P1): it is a mixed-locale human string, NOT a raw i18n key — it does NOT match the P1-objectivity raw-key regex ^[a-z]+(\.[a-z_]+){1,4}$ — so promoting it to P1 would violate the convergence rule. It is the author-noted footer string, correctly classified as a P2 quality defect.

The 'Commandes Actives' list is fetched UNPAGINATED. MyOrderComponent.vue active fetch (line ~238) sends only `excepts=DELIVERED|CANCELED|REJECTED|RETURNED` with NO `paginate`/`per_page` (the previous-orders fetch IS paginated, per_page=5). Result: the my-orders DOM (03.dom.html) is 1.8 MB and contains 1212 unique order serials / 1360 'N° Commande' nodes / ~1364 <li> — the screenshot only shows the top ~4 rows so the bloat is invisible visually. NOTE: this is NOT a privacy leak — FrontendOrderService::myOrder (FrontendOrderService.php:100) ANDs `where('user_id', auth()->user()->id)` inside the query group, so all 1212 are walkingcustomer's OWN accumulated dev-DB orders. P3 for V1-LOCAL (a real single customer has a handful of active orders); P2 defensible if customer order volume can grow large. The capture genuinely hid it.
findings.fix_hint: Paginate (or cap + 'see all') the activeOrder fetch like previousOrder, OR virtualize the active list. MyOrderComponent.vue activeOrderList dispatch ~line 238.

considered_non_findings.subject: PRIVACY / numeric_integrity — REFUTED
considered_non_findings.rationale: 1212 order serials in the 03 DOM are NOT a cross-customer leak. FrontendOrderService.php:100 `$query->where('user_id', auth()->user()->id)` is ANDed inside the query group => server-side scoped to the authed customer. State-04 detail DOM contains exactly ONE serial (#0306264118) matching the clicked row. 'walkingcustomer@example.com' is the only per-order customer; the other emails (admin/contact/pos/chef/bm) appear once each = footer/chrome, not order attribution. No P0.

considered_non_findings.subject: States 01 & 02 washed-out / near-white render
considered_non_findings.rationale: 01-login-idle and 02-login-bad-credentials PNGs are near-white/low-contrast, BUT a page-enter loading spinner (the '|||' bars) is visible in both => the snapshot was taken mid fade-in/opacity transition. States 03/04/05 render the SAME components and chrome fully opaque and correctly colored. This is a CAPTURE-TIMING artifact (mega-audit-snap fired during the enter animation), NOT a runtime contrast defect. Note as capture-quality P3-info; do NOT flag the login page as a contrast P1.

considered_non_findings.subject: 02 bad-credentials HTTP 400 + console error
considered_non_findings.rationale: 02.network.json: POST /api/auth/login => 400. 02.console.json has one 'Failed to load resource ... 400' entry whose location is the login URL (browser XHR log, NO app JS stack, not vendor-excluded but not an application code error). [role=alert] IS present and holds real French text 'Identifiants invalides ou compte bloqué' with a close button. Per task framing (400+visible alert = OK) this is the expected bad-creds path, CLEARED. Minor note: it is 400, while the protocol allowlist names 422 for validation — same intent (rejected creds), not a silent failure (alert shown).

considered_non_findings.subject: 05 two ERR_FAILED console errors on /api/frontend/order
considered_non_findings.rationale: 05.console.json has two net::ERR_FAILED on /api/frontend/order... — these are TEST-INDUCED via page.route('**/api/frontend/order**', abort('failed')) (spec lines 373-381) to exercise graceful degradation. Expected. The list correctly degraded to the honest empty state ('Aucune commande. Commencez par commander !' + 'Retour à l'accueil' CTA) — no white page, no crash. CLEARED.

considered_non_findings.subject: Empty-state quality (05)
considered_non_findings.rationale: 05 empty state has an illustration , copy ('Aucune commande. Commencez par commander !'), and a primary CTA ('Retour à l'accueil') => passes category-5 empty-state quality. Clean.

verdict: GREEN (no open P0/P1). KEY ASSERTION (order detail resolves the correct order by serial) is REAL and passes; no wrong-order / cross-customer privacy leak (query scoped to user_id). Disclosed non-blocking: L-001 P2 header cart button dark-on-dark + no aria-label (invisible on every customer page — the genuine MISS), L-002 P2 fr.json 'Useful Liens' mixed-locale, L-003 P3 unpaginated active-orders list (1.8MB DOM, own orders only). Live-status freshness half of the KEY ASSERTION is only an existence check (no defect found empirically).
